links.outcome: Model robustness to adversarial perturbations on the P-axis of the GAPS benchmark
links.effect: Models were reported as highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations (P-axis); performance also degraded sharply with reasoning depth (G-axis). No numeric effect sizes were given in the abstract.
links.quote: Evaluating state-of-the-art models on the benchmark revealed key failure modes: performance degrades sharply with increased reasoning depth (G-axis), models struggle with answer completeness (A-axis), and they are highly vulnerable to adversarial perturbations (P-axis) as well as certain safety issues (S-axis).

unlisted_practices: Fully automated guideline-anchored benchmark construction using an evidence neighborhood and graph and tree representations
Rubric synthesis by a DeepResearch agent using GRADE-consistent, PICO-driven evidence review
Scoring by an ensemble of LLM judges

screen.reason: The paper introduces and tests GAPS, an automated benchmark framework for evaluating the clinical grounding, completeness, robustness, and safety of LLMs/AI clinicians.
